correctness.rationale: The exact bounded martingale recursion x_n=(1-r_n)x_(n-1)+epsilon_n holds for every fixed binary rule sequence. Square summability yields convergence of noise. Divergent harmonic intervention weight forces zero by the monotone Toeplitz lemma. Finite weight yields an almost sure limit whose conditional variance is strictly positive, by a late Pólya step and strictly positive tail product. An independent Bernoulli centered harmonic series converges almost surely, transferring the exact threshold to arbitrary p_n. All 1,950 exact rational finite checks passed; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the vanishing-opposition boundary between the fixed-p Friedman deterministic limit and Pólya random limit. It gives a sharp harmonic weighted frequency law, a density-zero intervention phenomenon, the logarithmic threshold at exponent 1, and stronger quenched nondegeneracy. It is not a numerical slice or an unmotivated algebraic identity.
